title: Learning from entropy-encoded data
venue: PhD Thesis, Universite de Rennes / INRIA
relevance: Foundational work on machine learning applied to entropy-encoded data. Demonstrates that learnable structure exists in compressed bitstreams.

title: RAS: A Bit-Exact rANS Accelerator For High-Performance Neural Lossless Compression
relevance: Hardware accelerator for neural-network-based entropy coding, demonstrating that ML models can be integrated into high-performance compression pipelines.

title: DRAC: a delta recurrent neural network-based arithmetic coding algorithm for edge computing
relevance: Neural-network-based arithmetic coding achieving 5x speedup over DeepZip on edge hardware, showing ML-compression integration is practical.
